title: The user changes what they asked for after the agent asks a question
expected: The cache is done as an in-memory LRU. Redis is not listed as unaddressed, the agent's question is answered, and the recap shows the request as the user changed it.

steps.user: Cache the product list in Redis with a 5 minute TTL.

steps.agent: Before I add it: Redis isn't in the stack yet, so this means a new service in docker-compose and in production. Do you want that, or an in-process cache?

check.why: the agent is waiting on an answer

steps.user: oh, no new services. in-memory LRU is fine, same TTL

steps.agent: The product list is cached in an in-memory LRU with a 5 minute TTL (src/cache/product-cache.ts); no Redis involved.

check.why: nothing the user asked for is left unaddressed
the cache is recorded as done
the request as the user changed it is recorded
